name: Wirtshaus Hochfeldalm
kurzbeschreibung: No official record and no verifiable contact details could be found for the Wirtshaus Hochfeldalm in the Kufstein region.
beschreibung: The entry Wirtshaus Hochfeldalm cannot be clearly assigned to any officially confirmed catering establishment in Tirol. The coordinates provided point to the Kufstein region, more precisely to the Kufsteinerland around the municipality of Schwoich at the foot of the Kaisergebirge. This region is known above all for the Kufstein Fortress, the landmark of the town of Kufstein on the Inn, as well as for its proximity to the Wilder Kaiser. Research with the municipality of Schwoich and in the official company register of the Chamber of Commerce produced no entry under this name; neither a dedicated website nor any other contact details could be found. Therefore, no details regarding address, telephone, email or opening hours are deliberately provided, in order not to spread unsubstantiated information.
